title: P-cap1: 0xF000 is private use
description: draft-ietf-mimi-room-policy-04 §10.2: Specification Required range is '0x0000 to 0xF000' and Private Use is '0xF000 to 0xFFFF', so 0xF000 is in both. Readings: (a) 0xF000 is Specification Required; (b) 0xF000 is Private Use. Chosen: (b), the usual IANA convention (private range starts at the round boundary) and the more specific statement. Capability::is_private_use is true for 0xF000..=0xFFFF. WG item filed separately.
